issue.title: Regression in mypy 0.930: object.__reduce__

repository.name: typeshed
repository.description: Collection of library stubs for Python, with static types

issue.body:
In mypy 0.930 the signature for `object.__reduce__` has been changed to 
```python
    def __reduce__(self) -> str | Tuple[object, ...]: ...
```

This is wrong, reading [the documentation](https://docs.python.org/3/library/pickle.html#object.__reduce__). The following valid code now is reported as error:

```python
from typing import Any, Tuple, Union


class Diagnostic:
    def __reduce__(self) -> Union[str, Tuple[Any, ...]]:
        res = super().__reduce__()
        if isinstance(res, tuple) and len(res) >= 3:
            res[2]["_info"] = 42

        return res
```
